tools.name: send_invitations_email
tools.description: Sends the email invitation to all participants of a draw created in this same conversation. Each participant receives a personal email invitation. The send is immediate and cannot be recalled; a draw admits one bulk send. Takes the drawId and shareCode returned by create_draw.

tools.name: get_group_share_message
tools.description: Generates a ready-to-paste WhatsApp/Telegram message announcing a freshly created draw, which the user copies into the relevant chat. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_draw, get_group_share_message · Private data: create_draw · Public sink: create_draw, send_invitations_email, get_group_share_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_draw, get_group_share_message · Private data: create_draw · Public sink: create_draw, send_invitations_email, get_group_share_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
